thread:
elaine: Quick async — Veridian airlock cutover tomorrow am. Need a 1-line status from owners: networking, certs, registry sync, and ops runbook. I’ll be collecting for exec update.

sam: Net: firewall rules pushed but awaiting egress NAT IP from Veridian (they promised today). If no IP by 09:00 PT we fallback to egress-proxy in staging.

netty: Certs: CA signed, TLS certs in SecretsManager. Need @ops-bot to confirm rotation job ran successfully.

ops-bot: rotation-job(veridian-tls): success at 2026-03-17T21:02Z :white_check_mark:

jyoti: Registry sync: mirror job stalled on checksum mismatch for image redwood/private-runtime:1.3.2. Trying a re-pull + re-sign. ETA 40m.

maria: Runbook: I updated the cutover checklist at https://confluence/redwood/veridian-cutover — added rollback step for zone failover. @elaine can you confirm step 6 wording?

elaine: Yep saw it. Minor tweak — replace "force-promote" with "promote-with-healthcheck". Done.

sam: If NAT IP missing, who's the on-call to flip to egress-proxy? @netty or @maria for handover?

netty: I can do the proxy flip, but need ssh access to the bastion. maria, can you add me to the temporary allowlist? snippet of the command I'll run:
```
kubectl annotate svc egress-proxy release=canary --overwrite
kubectl rollout restart deployment/egress-proxy
```

maria: Added netty@veridian-bastion allowlist for 8 hours. FYI: firewall rule id fw-2734. Also opened a ticket: https://tickets/veridian/4589

jyoti: Registry re-sign completed. Mirror job now at 100%. Image digest: sha256:abcd1234. I pushed a smoke canary to staging. No regressions.

elaine: Awesome. Owners summary for exec: Net=waiting NAT IP (09:00 cutoff), Certs=rotated, Registry=synced, Runbook=updated + rollback clarified, EgressProxy owner=netty. Any blockers? If not I’ll send the update at 09:15 PT.

sam: No blockers from my side. +1

netty: No blockers. I'll standby for bastion creds.

maria: All clear. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-checklist(veridian-airlock): all green except external-nat (blocked) — will re-check at 09:05 PT.
